License:           The Unlicense, https://unlicense.org/

Used by the offline PWA scanner (assets/offline-scanner/) to verify the Ed25519 signatures of
offline ticket packages. To rebuild the minified file: `uglifyjs nacl-fast.js -c -m -o nacl-fast.min.js`
(uglify-js 3, the package's `npm run build`), or take nacl-fast.min.js from the npm package above.
